digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and calibration
propositions: Aliases 'sec' and 'documentation' must normalize to 'security' and 'docs' respectively before threshold routing to apply each criterion's tuned block threshold instead of the default 0.95 posture
Dimension labels must remain open by design—no fixed enum constraint on criteria—so project-supplied criteria and prompt-specified open dimensions pass through unnormalized
Normalization must check membership against the effective vocabulary (project overlay included) not the packaged routing index alone
The calibration document embeds five errors claiming missing criteria are unskippable when they are actually open dimensions or project criteria, and must be corrected in place without deletion
After 'documentation' → 'docs' normalization, high-impact docs findings must still surface because nit-suppression is impact-aware and drops only low-impact advisory findings
